name: polish
description: On the current branch, run a cleanup review, a language pass with the STE100 and Norwegian language skills, a universell utforming (accessibility) pass on interface code, a correctness review, and a security review with the security skills, round by round. The run stops when the project's check passes and a round finds nothing that affects correctness or a stated requirement, or at the round limit (default 3). The run always ends on a correctness review, and on a security review when the diff has files for the security skills. For a change to a web interface, it first writes behaviour tests when the project has component tests, and ends the report with a click-through when tests cannot show everything or a visual decision is open.
